heroSection.title: Permanent makeup in Chișinău
heroSection.text: Which feature do you usually emphasise with makeup? Choose an area to explore techniques, photos and prices.

descriptionSection.title: What is permanent makeup?
descriptionSection.text: Permanent makeup is cosmetic tattooing. Pigment is placed in the skin to define the brows, lips or lash line. The shade changes over time and how long it stays visible varies from person to person.

serviceSection.title: Techniques and prices
serviceSection.text: Prices are per area. Compare the finishes and consider which part of your everyday makeup you would like to recreate.

services.title: Permanent brows
services.text: Powder shading creates a soft background within the brow shape. If you usually fill in just the tail, show the artist where you prefer lighter shading.
services.alt: Dark arched brows with individual hairs visible near the nose

services.title: Permanent lip colour
services.text: A watercolour lip blush adds a soft wash of colour. For a more defined edge, ask about a shaded outline. A photo of your favourite lipstick can help explain how much colour you want.
services.alt: Matte pink lips with a defined outline

services.title: Permanent eyeliner
services.text: Lash enhancement defines the roots of the upper lashes. A separate eyeliner wing can extend past the outer corner. Discuss the length of the flick and whether you prefer a crisp or shaded edge.
services.alt: Black eyeliner with a sharply tapered wing at the outer corner

guide.title: Preparation and recovery
guide.text: Tell the artist if you already have cosmetic tattooing in the area. Ask how to prepare and how much time to allow. Before leaving, ask for aftercare instructions and agree when to share a photo of the healed colour.

guide.title: Touch-ups
guide.text: Once the area has healed, review the colour and shape. If you want a deeper shade or a small adjustment, discuss whether a touch-up would help, when to book and what it would cost.

gallerySection.title: Examples of our work
gallerySection.text: Compare lip outlines, brow shading and eyeliner styles. Open a photo for a closer look.

items.question: How much does permanent makeup cost in Chișinău?
items.answer: At Oblivion Tattoo, brows, lips and eyeliner each cost 900 MDL per area. Ask about the price of a possible touch-up separately.

items.question: Is cosmetic tattooing different from permanent makeup?
items.answer: On this page both terms refer to the same service. The technique determines the finish: a lip tattoo can emphasise the outline or add a soft wash of colour.

items.question: Which brow techniques are there?
items.answer: Powder shading adds colour beneath the hairs, while hair-stroke techniques imitate individual hairs. The studio lists powder brows on its menu.

items.question: When might I need a touch-up?
items.answer: If a patch looks lighter once healed, or you would like more colour, show the artist. A photo taken immediately after the procedure is too early to judge the finish.

items.question: What happens during a consultation?
items.answer: Tell the artist which area interests you and how you wear your makeup. Discuss shape, shade, previous cosmetic tattoos and appointment timing.

items.question: What should I know about recovery?
items.answer: Follow the aftercare advice for your area. If you have an event coming up, mention the date before booking because recovery times vary.

items.question: How do I choose a procedure?
items.answer: Start with the detail you draw most often: your brows, lip outline or lash line. Show the artist your usual makeup and a portfolio photo with a colour or shape you like.

items.question: How much does a tattoo cost in Chișinău?
items.answer: At 5–10 cm, black and grey costs 400–1300 MDL and colour costs 500–1500 MDL. At 10–20 cm, the ranges are 900–3500 and 1000–4000 MDL respectively.

items.question: How is the final price set?
items.answer: Size and colour give you a starting range. The artist looks at placement, fine details and the complexity of the design before confirming the price.

items.question: Can I bring my own design?
items.answer: Yes. Send the drawing ahead of time so the artist can discuss which details will work at your chosen size.

items.question: Do you cover old tattoos?
items.answer: Yes. Cover-ups and corrections start at 600 MDL. The artist reviews a photo to assess the colour and density of the existing work.

items.question: How do I book a consultation?
items.answer: Use the booking button to open the studio’s Telegram, describe your idea and suggest a time. You can also call the number in our contact details.

items.question: What should I consider before my session?
items.answer: Ask how long your session will take. Choose clothing that gives access to the area and discuss aftercare with the artist.

heroSection.text: At our studio at 65 Tighina Street, you can book ear, nose, lip, tongue and navel piercings. Each price includes basic jewelry.

firstCard.text: Bring a photo of a piercing you like so you can discuss the exact placement with your piercer.

heroSection.experience: We’ve been piercing for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}.
heroSection.imageAlt: Ear, nose and tongue piercing options

catalog.description: A lobe piercing sits in the soft part of the ear. A helix follows the outer cartilage rim, while a tragus sits in front of the ear canal. Other options include conch, daith and industrial.
A nostril piercing sits on one side of the nose. A septum piercing sits centrally between the nostrils. Each costs 250 MDL.
A single labret costs 200 MDL, a vertical labret 250 MDL and a tongue piercing 250 MDL. The list specifies how many piercings each paired style includes.
A navel piercing costs 300 MDL. Discuss placement with your piercer, especially if your waistband sits across your navel.
An eyebrow piercing costs 250 MDL and a bridge piercing costs 300 MDL. The nipple piercing price of 600 MDL covers two piercings.

process.title: Piercing

process.title: Aftercare

pricingSection.includesNote: If you want a different piece or a jewelry change after healing, ask about the material, availability and cost in advance.

items.question: How much does a piercing cost in Chișinău?
items.answer: Prices at Oblivion Tattoo start at 150 MDL for an earlobe. A helix costs 200 MDL and an eyebrow or tongue piercing costs 250 MDL.

items.question: Is jewelry included?
items.answer: Yes. The price covers the piercing and basic jewelry. Ask about the cost of other designs when booking.

items.question: How much is a nose or navel piercing?
items.answer: A nostril or septum piercing costs 250 MDL. A navel piercing costs 300 MDL with basic jewelry.

items.question: How do I choose jewelry?
items.answer: Show your piercer the look you have in mind. Ask which size suits a fresh piercing and what the piece is made of.

items.question: What should I consider before a piercing?
items.answer: Consider whether headphones, glasses or clothing will press on the area. If a health condition or medication could affect healing, speak to your doctor beforehand.

items.question: When should I contact the piercer or seek medical help?
items.answer: Contact your piercer if the jewelry catches or feels tight. Seek urgent medical care if pain and swelling increase, the skin feels hot, you notice pus or you develop a fever.
